description: Detect breaking changes in an agent or API you depend on. Pass `prior` and `current` snapshots (version, protocol, endpoint, permissions, task_result, claims_hash) and get the material changes with a REVIEW_CHANGE / NO_MATERIAL_CHANGE_OBSERVED signal and a receipt. Free, read-only, no account. Inputs must be public and non-personal; calling declares that (data_classification defaults to PUBLIC).

counterparty_id.description: Name or URL of the agent/service. Optional.

protocol.description: Counterparty protocol. Inferred from metadata when omitted, otherwise MCP.

name: gaip_compare_supplier_snapshots
title: Compare supplier snapshots
